fields.Name: T110 - Dashboard Browser View Mode Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the ViewMode='cards' vs 'list' branch in the generic browser template (two entirely separate render blocks: dashboard-grid vs dashboard-list with a column header row) and the SetViewMode toggle + persistence path — not the generic grid or open/create paths already covered.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), open the Data Explorer app, then go to its Dashboards section. In the browser toolbar there is a two-button view toggle on the right (a grid/'grip' icon for Card View and a lines/'list' icon for List View). Click the List View button, then click the Card View button. Success is seeing the dashboard listing re-render in the two different layouts as you toggle (cards laid out in a grid vs. rows with Name / Type / Modified columns), and the active toggle button highlighting the current mode. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Both a Card View and a List View toggle button are visible in the Dashboards toolbar

Clicking List View re-renders the listing as rows with column headers (Name / Type / Modified), and Card View re-renders it as a grid of cards (either layout may show an empty-state if there are no dashboards)
The toggle button for the currently-active mode is visually highlighted/selected
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
